description: Use this when the user asks how much a profession pays in a country or city. Returns the median salary, the spread (25th-75th percentile on country sites, or mean and 1-sigma range for Russia; see `method`), the sample size of active vacancies, the currency and period, and a link to the Finder salary page for that profession and city. Figures are computed from advertised salaries in active vacancies, not from payroll data. Do not use to list vacancies.

city.description: City where the user wants to work (search filter), as written locally, e.g. 'Минск', 'Алматы', 'Berlin'. Not the user's current location; do not pass coordinates or addresses. Empty = whole country
city.title: City

country.description: Country ISO code: ru (Russia, finder.work), by, kz, kg, de, fr, be, ch, se, id, at, ar, ec, pa, gb, ie, cz, uz, no, sk, bg, fi, es, pl, sg, nz, mx, co, au, us, cl, pe, cr, gt, ca, nl, it, ro, cy, uy, do, ni, py, hr, si, lv, mt, lu, in, za, ke, hu, ng, ph, gh, ug, hn, sv, pt, tn. Call list_countries if unsure.
country.title: Country

profession.description: Profession in the local language, e.g. 'Бухгалтер', 'Programmierer'. Empty = all jobs
profession.title: Profession
